title: 🎬 STRONGHOLDS: THE VERSE DEPLOYED
paragraphs:
🎬 STRONGHOLDS: THE VERSE DEPLOYED
When culture sends the invoice, faith doesn’t quote — it deploys.
Because Scripture isn’t just words… it’s warfare.
🔥 #FaithInAction isn’t about silence — it’s about strategy.

🕊️ “For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strongholds.”
— 2 Corinthians 10:4 ✝️
⚔️ We don’t retreat from darkness — we rewrite it with light.
💬 Drop “🔥” if you’re done quoting verses and ready to deploy them.
